name: codex-mesh
description: Delegate Codex tasks to a private, self-hosted fleet of computers.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex work across your private computers.
interface.longDescription: Codex Mesh connects one controller to any number of self-hosted worker computers. Route read-only or workspace-scoped Codex tasks, follow progress, cancel work, and share explicitly approved project memory without exposing Codex directly to the public internet.
defaultPrompt: Show all Codex Mesh nodes and their current status
Run a read-only task on one of my remote computers
Search shared project memory before delegating work
